item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a bar magnet, an iron screw, and an aluminium spoon. Nidhi brings the magnet near each object. The screw is attracted. The spoon is not.

Which conclusion is correct?

options.A: The screw is made of a magnetic material; the spoon is not.
options.B: The spoon is made of a magnetic material; the screw is not.
options.C: Both are magnetic because Nidhi used a bar magnet near them.
options.D: Both are non-magnetic because only one object moved.
